title: Binary inner product of joined blocks
statement: For any natural number $n$ and vectors $x,y\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$, the inner product modulo two of the vector formed by joining $x$ and $y$ is $\sum_{i=1}^n x_i y_i$ in $\mathbb{F}_2$.
